items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section X, List of Answers on Topics 50:1
items.html: For Mantzapach are Bina and ZON that went outward, whose essence is the ZAT, and so too they are HGT and NH, which are ZAT. (See answer 134).
